```yaml
name: Pro Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'  # Monday at 6 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: 'pro-integration-tests'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Check for GitHub PAT
      id: check-pat
      run: echo ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Skip if PAT is not set
      if: steps.check-pat.outputs.github_token == ''
      run: exit 0

    - name: Run integration tests
      run: npm test -- --testPathPattern='^tests/pro/'
```
